mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.id AS attemptId, p.payment_no AS paymentNo, r.merchant_request_no AS attemptNo, r.channel_id AS channelId, c.channel_code AS channelCode, r.status AS status, r.submitted_at AS submittedAt, r.closed_at AS closedAt, (r.close_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL) AS hasCloseEvidence, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.version AS version
FROM tc_payment_attempt r JOIN tc_payment_intent p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.id=r.intent_id JOIN tc_merchant_channel c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.channel_id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{offset}
